title: caltha palustris subsp. araneosa
intro: Caltha palustris subsp. araneosa, commonly known as marsh marigold, is a plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of marsh marigold include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin irritations, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of marsh marigold include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
